meta.name: migrate-slack-agents
meta.description: Migrate a classic single-bot Slack install to one provisioned Slack app per existing agent group while preserving agent identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring behavior — or record the operator's choice to stay on classic, which remains supported. Use when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone any time later.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 Slack 机器人架构为每组独立应用，保留身份与记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在使用经典 Slack 机器人并需按 agent 分组独立应用
copy.tagline_en: Migrate classic Slack bots to per-agent apps, preserving identities and memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a classic Slack bot setup and need per-agent Slack apps

howto.what: 把经典的单机器人 Slack 安装,按每个已有 agent group 迁移成独立的 slack-<slug> 应用,保留 agent 身份、工作区、记忆和接线行为;也可记录你选择继续用 classic 的决定。过程由操作者引导、可断点续跑,不创建 agent group、不改 agent 工作区。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 提示 Slack agents 要求时触发,或之后随时单独运行 /migrate-slack-agents;检测到经典共享机器人状态后会先询问你是否迁移。

say.text: 帮我把 Slack agents 迁移成每个 agent 一个独立应用
say.note: 先给 dry-run 映射表让你确认

say.text: 我选择继续用 classic,不要迁移
say.note: 不做改动,只记录这次决定

say.text: 先给我一份迁移的 dry-run 映射表
say.note: 列出旧接线与拟建 slack-<slug> 表面对应

howto.what_en: Migrates a classic Slack install to one provisioned slack-<slug> app per existing agent group, keeping identities, workspaces, memory and wiring, or records your choice to stay on classic. Never creates an agent group or edits a workspace.
howto.when_en: Triggers when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or when you run /migrate-slack-agents standalone later. If classic state is found, it first asks whether to migrate.

say_en.text: Migrate my Slack agents to one app per agent group
say_en.note: Shows a dry-run map for confirmation

say_en.text: I'll stay on classic, don't migrate
say_en.note: No changes; only records the decision

say_en.text: Show me the dry-run migration map first
say_en.note: Lists old wirings vs proposed slack-<slug> surfaces
